title: Alien hunter claims Trump could unveil UFO proof to distract from midterm defeat
excerpt: A UFO filmmaker claims Donald Trump could pull off the ultimate political stunt by unveiling a living extraterrestrial to distract from a brutal midterm election defeat.
content:
Liam Randall

Updated Mon, November 9, 2026 at 12:10 AM UTC

A UFO researcher claims Donald Trump could execute the ultimate political maneuver by revealing a living extraterrestrial to divert attention from a devastating election loss.

Filmmaker and alien investigator Jon Stewart believes the embattled Republican might resort to "catastrophic disclosure" to capture worldwide attention after Democrats secured victories in both the House and Senate.

Stewart suggests the Commander-in-Chief, with his "back to the wall", could potentially unveil an actual E.T. or a recovered flying saucer in a last-ditch effort to sway public opinion.

In an interview with FOX 32 Chicago, Stewart argued that UFO enthusiasts and researchers have been disappointed by years of unclear footage and government secrecy.

"There is a perceivable thud that has been felt in the UFO community to the fact that we have not had the kind of disclosure that we had been promised," Stewart said, reports the Daily Star.

"It's been your blips and your fuzzy lights on a video screen from a fighter jet. And now the shellacking that the Republicans took and President Trump with his proverbial back to the wall. This is a huge letdown."

He continued: "The UFO community is scrambling for answers on how we could possibly react to this. I am a proverbial optimist, and I think Donald Trump is going to try and throw a Hail Mary, hit that home run.

"I think he might use catastrophic disclosure as a way to rally the citizens of Rome around him and have a four-day Colosseum extravaganza like they did back in the Roman days."

Stewart believes the ultimate revelation would involve biological alien life or high-definition images of recovered extraterrestrial technology concealed deep within classified military installations.

"I mean something where we get catastrophic disclosure of a live extraterrestrial, a dead extraterrestrial in retention in a government facility, or a clear 4K resolution craft underground in one of these government facilities like S2 Alpha, the Dugway Proving Grounds under Michael's Airfield, or Tonopah Air Base above Area 51," he said.

"With those buzzwords, there are government people getting nervous because we're talking about the bases where this craft and biologics are held, without a doubt."

Stewart said: "Trump would be willing to throw the Hail Mary and show the world in the United States, 'Hey, look, I'm on your side, here's your catastrophic disclosure.'".

"There is new renewed hope that we may get a peek inside or at least find out the truth of what's going on underground in Wright-Patterson Air Force Base. This is a very, very scary base and we might get a peek behind the curtain and some truth about it."

Despite these extraordinary claims, no such dramatic disclosure event has been announced by the White House. Official agencies have repeatedly dismissed allegations of extraterrestrial beings being held in government custody.

The Pentagon's All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) asserts that past investigations have revealed no credible proof of retrieved or reverse-engineered extraterrestrial technology.

NASA has likewise stated that although it advocates for openness regarding unidentified aerial phenomena, it has discovered no reliable evidence connecting unexplained observations to beings from another world.
